cohort: 3,792 patients undergoing cesarean delivery in 183 hospitals across 22 countries in Africa
finding: Maternal mortality after caesarean delivery in Africa was found to be 50 times higher than that of high-income countries and was primarily driven by peripartum haemorrhage and anaesthesia complications.
mod_finding: This study investigated risk factors for maternal and neonatal mortality in Africa, but it did not specifically examine mode of delivery as a risk factor.
